title: DNA Extraction from Water/Soil Using 50-50-50 Buffer-Chloroform/Pheol Method
author: Stef Van Der Merwe
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8yphxvn

steps.title: Prepare sample in tube
steps.instruction: Place sample material into a 2 mL microcentrifuge tube according to type.

substeps.instruction: For membrane filters: in a laminar flow hood, use sterile forceps to transfer the filter to a petri dish, cut into ~0.5–1 cm² pieces with flame‑sterilised scissors, and place 8–10 pieces into a 2 mL tube.
For soil or sediment: weigh ~0.8 g into a 2 mL tube containing 0.4–0.5 mL glass microbeads; ensure the tube has a locking lid or screw cap.

steps.title: Add extraction reagents
steps.instruction: Add buffer and reducing agent to the tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL extraction buffer.
Add 1 µL of 1 M dithiothreitol (DTT) into the tube lid.

steps.title: Vortex for cell lysis
steps.instruction: Seal tubes, place in zip‑lock bag, vortex.

substeps.instruction: Close lids, put tubes in a zip‑lock bag to prevent leakage, tape bag to vortex so tubes lie flat.
Vortex 10–12 min at ~3000 rpm.
Remove tubes from bag, briefly invert to release any material stuck in lids.
Centrifuge 3 min at 14,000 × g.
Decant supernatant carefully into a sterile 2 mL tube, avoiding any filter pieces.

steps.title: First phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Extract DNA with phenol and chloroform:isoamyl alcohol.

substeps.instruction: Determine volume of supernatant; add half of that volume of phenol and half of that volume of chloroform:isoamyl alcohol.
Vortex until solution appears milky.
Centrifuge 3 min at 14,000 × g (or until phases separate).
Using a sterile tip, transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new sterile 2 mL tube.
Measure volume of the aqueous phase and add an equal volume of chloroform.
Centrifuge as above.
Transfer the new upper aqueous phase to a sterile 2 mL tube.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with alcohol
steps.instruction: Add sodium acetate and isopropanol, mix, and spin.

substeps.instruction: Determine volume of the aqueous extract.
Add 0.1 × volume of 3 M sodium acetate and 0.7 × volume of isopropanol.
Mix by inverting the tube several times; do not vortex.
Centrifuge 30 min at 14,000 × g in a 10 °C refrigerated centrifuge.
Carefully aspirate the supernatant, ensuring the DNA pellet remains attached to the tube wall.

steps.title: Ethanol wash and second spin
steps.instruction: Wash pellet with cold ethanol and re‑centrifuge.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.5 mL ice‑cold 70 % ethanol, invert gently to wet pellet.
Centrifuge 5 min at 14,000 × g in a 10 °C refrigerated centrifuge.
Aspirate ethanol carefully, avoiding the pellet.
Allow pellet to air‑dry for 2–5 min.
Add 50 µL DNase/RNase‑free water.
Mix by gently flicking until pellet dissolves; do not use nanopure or DI water.

steps.title: Optional further clean‑up
steps.instruction: If needed, purify DNA with commercial kits or PVPP columns.

steps.title: Optional pooling of extracts
steps.instruction: Combine and reconcentrate if pooling is required.
